en:
## New Features

- Added richer agent diagnostics and request visibility to make troubleshooting model runs easier.
- Improved recent-tab navigation by prefetching narrator data and messages for faster panel opening.

## Bug Fixes

- Stabilized subagent detach/attach lifecycle handling to prevent stuck background tasks and stale cancellation state.
- Fixed interrupted attach flows so detached subagents continue to be managed as background tasks.
- Localized Pipeline tool cards in the message UI and Pixi renderer.
- Reduced unnecessary message reloads by keeping message caches alive longer while still trimming large histories.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 增强 agent 诊断与请求可见性，便于排查模型运行问题。
- 为最近标签页预取叙述者与消息数据，打开会话面板更快。

## 修复

- 稳定子代理 detach/attach 生命周期，避免后台任务卡住或保留过期取消状态。
- 修复 attach 等待被中断后子代理状态不一致的问题，确保仍按后台任务管理。
- 补齐 Pipeline 工具卡在消息 UI 与 Pixi 渲染器中的本地化文案。
- 延长消息缓存保留时间并保留历史裁剪，减少不必要的消息重载。
